headline: Gondola 3A goes before TMVOA Board of Directors Budget Meeting #3 on Thursday, December 3
blurb: The Telluride Mountain Village Owners Association holds its third budget board meeting to adopt the 2027 budget by resolution — the main event. Also on the action list: approval of a SMART IGA, which connects this session directly to the ongoing gondola funding structure. The board will review the proposed 2027 meeting calendar before opening the floor to public comment. Any decisions made here head to the full Members Meeting on December 17.
